title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999, s 38-285 Water
archive_note: Extract of the operative provision. A statutory provision, which under source precedence outranks the Commissioner's ruling and any utility page.
establishes: A supply of water in Australia is GST-free by statute (s 38-285)
Sewerage and sewerage-like services, septic tank emptying and storm water draining are GST-free under the same Subdivision 38-I
does_not_establish: The treatment of every line on a water bill. GSTR 2000/25 names plans of sewer pipe locations and photocopying as taxable, and excludes Division 81 taxes and fees from its scope. Nothing modelled in the Perth record falls outside the supply of water.
